summary.accuracySource: all discovered weapon hits / all discovered weapon shots

matchHistory.note: Run BIND_CS2_MATCH_HISTORY.cmd to enable Valve official match-sharing-code tracking.

dataQuality.note: Missing Steam stat keys are stored as null and displayed as —, never coerced to 0. Displayed accuracy is always recalculated from all discoverable per-weapon hit/shot counters. Map discovery is dynamic, but Valve may omit map keys upstream.

matchSource.steamWebApi: GetUserStatsForGame exposes aggregate CS2 stats. Valve match history uses a separate Game Authentication Code + match sharing code flow.
matchSource.heybox: No verified Heybox match-history endpoint returned rows in this build.

heybox.note: Heybox account connected and its bound SteamID64 matches the bound Steam identity.

playnite.note: CS2 total playtime displayed on the record page uses the Playnite exported total.
